title: fix(pm): owed-review list and H43 read contract-review verdicts the way the queue guard does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96tjD88ekDePkUD1g3E7yns)_

Fixes #33705

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:「待复核清单」和巡查 H43 现在跟合并队列守卫一样读复核记录,只认中继账号和 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 发的记录,且只认恰好一行 `VERDICT:`。
- 为什么改:之前这两个工具读任何人发的记录、取第一个匹配,会把守卫拒收的 PR 显示成"已复核/PASS"。
- 风险与回滚:只影响显示和巡查,不影响落地;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h43RecordAuthors` 与 `h43HandoffReading`;`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `recordReading`;守卫里新导出的 `recordTrustedAuthors`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`,预期 89 例全过,含 #33705 新增的不受信作者与两行 VERDICT 用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Queue guard** (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`): new pure export `recordTrustedAuthors(bot)`, the relay login plus `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, frozen. `loadRecordRecognisers` now builds its `trustedAuthors` with it. Same set, one assembly. The predicate `recordAuthorTrusted` was already exported. The set was assembled inline in the loader, so the owed-review list had no way to import it, and this export is the one guard change.
- **Owed-review list** (`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`):
  - `recordReading` drops comments whose author the guard does not trust from both threads before `locateReviewOfRecord` reads them. It uses the guard's `recordAuthorTrusted` with `RECORD_AUTHORS = recordTrustedAuthors(FLEET_BOT_LOGIN)`. An untrusted record is never the record and never shadows one. The drop count rides on the row and is printed (`record none (1 by an untrusted author not read)`).
  - `verdictOf` counts the lines with `contractReviewVerdictLines`, the guard's reader, instead of a first-match regex: one line gives its word, none gives `unstated`, two or more give `ambiguous`.
- **H43 patrol** (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`):
  - `latestContractReviewOnHead` carries the word of the record's ONE `VERDICT:` line (`contractReviewVerdictLines`), null with none or two.
  - `h43HandoffReading(rows, head, authors)` reads the PASS only among comments `authors.admits`. With no binding, or one that did not load, the thread is UNREAD (UNJUDGED), never judged on every author.
  - `h43RecordAuthors()` is the binding: the guard's own `recordAuthorTrusted` with the set the guard's own `loadRecordRecognisers` assembles. It is loaded once, at sweep time. The loader imports files that import `check-half-states.mjs`, so a call at module scope or inside `--self-test` would deadlock. The register carries the guard's predicate and loader beside the matcher.
  - A binding that does not load names its reason on H43's coverage clause (`governedRecordAuthorsReason`, added to `SWEEP_COUNT_KEYS`).
  - The first-match `contractReviewVerdictOf` has no caller left. Its docblock now says so and fences it off. Removing it is left as an open question.

## Why

After #33687 the queue guard reads a Tier S record only from the relay or `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and only on exactly one `VERDICT:` line. The two display/patrol readers did neither. They could show a PR as reviewed, or its record as PASS, where the guard refuses it, and H43 could summon the approvers on a drive-by PASS.

## Tests

Self-test rows added, in both tools (`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`: 89 cases, 10 batteries; `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: 5278 cases, battery `H43 hand-off timing` 111 of floor 88):

- an untrusted author's PASS on this head is not read: owed-reviews reads `none` and the PR stays owed; H43 reads BEFORE.
- a newer untrusted PASS does not shadow a trusted FAIL on the same head, in either tool.
- a record posted by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` is read.
- a two-line record (PASS, then a quoted FAIL; and FAIL then PASS) reads `ambiguous` in owed-reviews and is no PASS for H43, as the guard reads it.
- a heading-inline or bare PASS with no `VERDICT:` line is `unstated` / no PASS.
- H43: no binding, or an unloaded one, reads UNREAD. `h43RecordAuthors` names its reason for an unloaded register, a guard without the exports, a loader that throws and a loader that answers unavailable. The real register carries the guard's own predicate and loader, and the binding admits the relay and each approver and refuses others.

Battery floors raised: owed-reviews `the record: …` 8 → 13; half-states `H43 hand-off timing` 80 → 88.

**Forced test edits** (named): the existing fixtures had no author, so under the binding every record in them would be unread.
- owed-reviews `recordRow` and `deltaRow` gain `user.login` = the relay.
- half-states `rows43` gains `user.login` = the relay.
- `DUE43`, `BEFORE43` and the `reading` helper pass the fixture binding `AUTH43`.

No assertion's expected value changed.

Ablation: not run. These are tooling scripts, which os-dev's standard clauses exempt from ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Only the contract-review record and its verdict are author-bound, as the card asks. The `## 席位核对` ACCEPT that H43 also reads, and the owed-review list's hand-off, claim and hold lines, are still read from any author. That is the same class of gap, outside this card's surface. It is noted here, not filed.
- The guard also refuses a single PASS line that carries a FAIL spelling or an open must-fix/should-fix (#33604). Neither tool mirrors that part. The decision sits inline in the guard's `recordPassVerdict` and is not exported, so reading it here would mean a second copy.
- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (held by #33789) is not touched.
